answer.summary: No explicit non-feature-based indicators of implicit sequence coherence in agent memory are described under stable, low-variation input conditions in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1.
answer.content: The review confirms the absence of any explicitly stated, observable, non-feature-based mechanisms for contextual continuity in agent memory under stable input conditions. The evidence aligns with prior findings that such mechanisms, if present, are not described in the source material, reinforcing the need to maintain a strictly bounded, source-fidelity-based inquiry without speculative inference or external assumptions.
answer.lesson: When evaluating agent memory mechanisms, a bounded inquiry must restrict analysis to explicitly stated, non-feature-based, and directly observable phenomena in primary sources to preserve fidelity and avoid unfounded inference
